home.hero_title: Learn the Quran with Love, Anywhere in the World
home.hero_subtitle: Live one-on-one and family group lessons in Quran, Tajweed, Hifz and Islamic Studies, taught over WhatsApp audio classes.
home.why_1_text: One account for the whole family. Every child can join lessons using the same phone.
home.why_2_text: No apps to install. Join your class through WhatsApp audio, just like calling a relative.
home.why_3_text: Structured Quran, Tajweed and Islamic Studies lessons from an experienced teacher.

about.title: About Our Academy
about.mission: Our mission is to make authentic, structured Quran and Islamic education accessible to every family, wherever they live, in a simple and affordable way.

admission.title: Admission Form
admission.subtitle: Fill this form once for your whole family. No email address is required.
admission.success: Your application has been received! You can check its status any time on the Admission page using your contact number.

auth.login_help: Family accounts: use the username and password given to you after your admission was accepted.

family_dashboard.title: Family Dashboard
family_dashboard.no_link_yet: Your teacher has not set a class link yet. Please contact us on WhatsApp.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: We respect your family's privacy. Information you share with us -- including contact details, student names, and questions -- is used only to provide Quran and Islamic Studies education and is never shared with any other family or third party. Each family can only see their own information. We do not sell or share your data, and we do not process any payments through this website.

common.no_price_notice: Haseen Quran and Islamic Studies Academy is committed to providing quality online Quran education and authentic Islamic knowledge. Our aim is to help students improve their Quran recitation, Tajweed, memorization, and understanding of Islamic teachings through structured lessons and personalized guidance. For information about our courses and enrollment, please contact us directly.
